sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New 🧾 Activity log, in the SAED menu (Help, below ❓ Help) and in the Tampermonkey menu: what the script did on this page, one line per step, inside the page, so you can send it with a bug report without opening the browser's console. Each line shows its time, level, the console's icon and channel, and the message. A filter box keeps the lines with your text and marks it; Level and Channel chips show one kind at a time; Record detail records every step for this page only; ⧉ Copy as Markdown copies everything, ready for a forum post or a GitHub issue, naming the script and library versions, the page type and the page's address; Clear asks first. The window moves, resizes and goes full screen, and is full screen on a phone. When a warning or an error was logged, the menu row shows how many (an amber "2 ⚠", a red "1 ✖").

The window itself is VZ_MBLibrary 4.7.0/4.7.1's (Lib.logWindow, based on majkinetor's mbuLog from his Musicbrainz Toolset, with his permission). ShowAllEntityData puts it in MusicBrainz's own body, so a window opened while Event Horizon's view is on comes back after V, and gives it the page type for the copy. A debug line while debug logging is off is still not recorded at all, so nothing gets slower.
